name: Portuguese expedition
goals: Seek the release of the captives.
After the conquest, find who can carry petitions under the new authorities.
bio: A visiting fleet, a stranded factor and a conqueror’s appointments belong to different moments. For local households, a safeguard from one Portuguese commander does not settle every demand that follows.
notes: fact: Sequeira’s visit preceded Araújo’s captivity and Albuquerque’s 1511 expedition; Fernandes subsequently went to Siam on a Chinese junk (1511-events.md §1; Birch III, pp. 152–155)
gameplay: This is a cross-phase index of the expedition and an aftermath contact, not a claim that Sequeira served on the 1511 fleet or Regimo belonged to it (people-factions.md §§1–2)
